title: The Raffle — EN/FR/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar French Italian language learning dry wit deadpan 102bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Year four. A school raffle.
First. Second. Third. No one clapped.
The odds were not in their favour.
That is what happened.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Quatrième année. Une tombola scolaire. (Year four. A school raffle.)
Six mille cinq cents dollars de prix. (Six thousand five hundred dollars of prizes.)
Premier. Deuxième. Troisième. Personne n'a applaudi. (First. Second. Third. No one clapped.)
Les probabilités n'étaient pas en leur faveur. (The odds were not in their favour.)
C'est ce qui s'est passé. (That is what happened.)
Parfois gagner (Sometimes winning)
Est la chose la plus solitaire de la salle. (Is the loneliest thing in the room.)

[Chorus - Italian, with English translations]
La lotteria (The raffle)
Primo, secondo, terzo (First, second, third)
La lotteria (The raffle)
Mattoni Midland — hanno preso tutto (Midland bricks — they got it all)
La lotteria (The raffle)
Nessuno ha applaudito al terzo (Nobody clapped at third)
La lotteria (The raffle)
A volte vincere (Sometimes winning)
È la cosa più solitaria nella stanza (Is the loneliest thing in the room)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Win the substance. Soften the visibility.
French: Gagnez le fond. Adoucissez la visibilité. (Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)
Italian: Vinci la sostanza. Addolcisci la visibilità. (Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)

[Outro - all three]
English: The bricks are still there.
French: Les briques sont encore là. (The bricks are still there.)
Italian: I mattoni sono ancora lì. (The bricks are still there.)
